title: Listening Drill — Riverside litter project — Trial review
description: Conversation about a trial. One synthetic recording, six questions. Recommended time: 7 minutes.

sections.title: Riverside litter project — Trial review
sections.transcript:
HOST: You ran two introductory sessions on riverside litter project last week. What happened in the first one?

GUEST: On the first run, several people reported a problem with mixed objects. At first we wondered whether it was a problem with the instructions. A closer inspection revealed the fault: broken handle.

HOST: What changed when you ran the session again?

GUEST: On each trial, we now keep a record of material types so changes can be compared. For the second trial we let everyone borrow litter tongs instead of bringing their own. That helped us keep the equipment as consistent as possible.

HOST: What should people who attended do now?

GUEST: Send any suggestions directly to the volunteer leader before the next group arrives. The next group comes on Sunday, so we have time to compare notes beforehand.
